function syncSkeletonLayer(component): void

Defined in: core/utils/canvas/loaders/skeleton-webgl.ts:328

Keeps a component's skeleton layer in sync with its rendered content. Call from onUpdated()/onMounted(): creates the layer while skeleton nodes exist, re-measures after every render, resolves it once they are gone.

Parameters

component

BaseComponent

The host component whose content is being watched.

Returns

void
